_comment: Every sentence the product generates about a patient comes from here. Fixed templates, variables only. No model writes any of this at runtime.

doctor_confirmation.acknowledged: {patient_name} acknowledged the {drug} savings card. Pharmacy fill confirmation is still pending.
doctor_confirmation.filled: {patient_name}: {drug} pharmacy fill confirmed. This does not confirm treatment start.

patient_card.title: {drug} savings card
patient_card.acknowledged: Savings card acknowledged. Pharmacy fill confirmation is still pending.
patient_card.filled: The pharmacy confirmed your fill. This does not confirm a first dose.

patient_message._comment: C3 (6.8): the coordinator-approved message to the patient, voiced with ElevenLabs. Access logistics only, never medical advice. Spanish needs a native speaker's review.
patient_message.title: Message from your practice

text.en: Your {drug} savings card is ready. Show it at the pharmacy.
text.es: Su tarjeta de ahorro para {drug} está lista. Muéstrela en la farmacia.

before_visit_card.text: {patient_name}: {drug} first fill confirmation is still pending. Review fill status before the visit.

board.price_to_label: $0 with copay card (as little as $0, per {manufacturer})

access_screen.title: Market Access · aggregate only
access_screen.footer: Aggregate counts of prescribed cases with a pharmacy fill confirmation. No names or counts by prescriber. A fill does not establish treatment start or clinical recovery.
access_screen.source_practice: Practice event counts · simulated pharmacy · Tiger unavailable
access_screen.tiger_unavailable: Tiger summary unavailable. Showing practice event counts.
